ecl.text: Kirol is on a class trip to the Harrier's Wood with Abigale, Sanar and Tamira when a faerie lures them through an Omenpath, and all four tumble through a hole and land in a meadow that is not on Arcavios.
The students wake the moon-headed creature in a silver-lit chamber, and Kirol yanks Sanar away as they flee.
Later in the Gilt-Leaf Wood a hunter named Lluwen seizes Kirol and brings them before High Perfect Morcant, who wants to poison the creature, Isilu, and forces Kirol to gather dawnglove for her.
Kirol refuses to go back for more, Ajani bursts in and takes Kirol away, and Lluwen follows, then helps steal Morcant's vial of dawnglow so the students can reach Maralen.

sos.text: Kirol is back at Strixhaven, dissolving a restless spirit in the Fields of Strife with a war cry, and Ajani becomes Kirol's advisor for the Pranticle Peak expedition.
When an archaic carries Jadzi away, Kirol requisitions a horse and leaves before Ajani returns, then reunites with Abigale and Sanar at Titan's Grave to search for Lluwen.
Trapped beneath the earth, Kirol claims the job of going with Lluwen to scout a way out and promises not to leave him behind when roots seize him.
In the final fight, Lluwen spots Jadzi's unfinished chain spell on the archaic and urges everyone to finish it, and Kirol rallies the others to follow him.
